project.title: MAEV Digital Media Strategy
project.description: A strategic digital media project developed for MAEV, a modern clothing brand, covering market analysis, competitive analysis, SWOT analysis, target audience, user persona, strategic objectives, content strategy, digital tactics, and performance measurement.
project.problem: MAEV needs a clear digital media direction that can establish a recognizable brand presence, reach the right audience, differentiate the brand within a competitive clothing market, and turn social media activity into measurable business outcomes.
project.solution: This project develops a structured digital media strategy for MAEV by analyzing the market and competitors, defining the target audience and user persona, establishing strategic objectives, developing content and media tactics, and creating a KPI framework for continuous performance measurement and optimization.
project.businessValue: Provides MAEV with a practical digital roadmap for building brand awareness, engaging the target audience, differentiating from competitors, guiding content creation, and measuring digital marketing performance through clear strategic objectives and KPIs.
